subject: CLAIM: kernel-side sources sync to P14 stage
body: Per coordinator: I claim gpu/include/nord2_gpu_*.h, gpu/src/nord2_gpu_*.c + Nord2GPU.cpp, shim/nord2-xnu/*, gpu/tests/nord2_*_test.c (kernel-side tests only) for a byte-identical sync to _final-tree (P14).
